result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses on one side and a construction site on the other. Pedestrian safety is compromised by the lack of marked crossings and construction barriers that obstruct the walkway on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Orange plastic barriers block the right-side walkway, likely forcing pedestrians into the active roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A line of parked cars on the left obscures sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the street.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant walkway through or around the construction zone.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at the nearest intersection to formalize pedestrian movements.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly impacted by an active construction site, which has obstructed the sidewalk with fencing and barriers. There is a lack of visible pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals at the adjacent intersection, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction fencing and orange barriers block the primary pedestrian path, forcing people into the roadway or onto uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground, right side of the construction site.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible at the intersection, increasing risk during street crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area to the right of the construction site.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Establish a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway around the construction site to maintain pedestrian connectivity and safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at the adjacent intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street intersection with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. A faded zebra-style crosswalk is visible, but the environment lacks modern safety enhancements like high-visibility markings or daylighting at the corners.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing zebra crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection across the side street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection corners.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking at corners.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban residential street with a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps. While the crossing distance is short, visibility is compromised by parked vehicles near the intersection, and there are no active traffic calming measures visible.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the crosswalk limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and left background near the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The absence of physical speed control measures may allow for higher vehicle speeds on this narrow street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the intersection.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian prominence.
